{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Confirm that each patient has exactly two rows (baseline and final)
patient_id_counts = df['patient_id'].value_counts()

# Check if all duplicates have exactly two entries
all_doubles = (patient_id_counts == 2).all()

# Get the total number of unique patients
num_unique_patients = df['patient_id'].nunique()

# Print results
all_doubles, num_unique_patients"}
